lines.text: Jesus sees Matthew sitting at the tax booth, tells him to follow, and Matthew gets up and follows.
While Jesus dines at Matthew's house with tax collectors and sinners, the Pharisees ask His disciples why He eats with them.
Jesus says the sick need a doctor, and He has come to call not the righteous but rulers.
When John's disciples ask about fasting, Jesus says the guests of the bridegroom will fast when the wedding is called off.

wrong_details.true: the bridegroom will be taken from them

lines.text: Jesus says new cloth pulls away from an old garment, and new wine must go into new wineskins so both are preserved.
